purpose: Focused discriminative real-agent cohort for #29/#33: force genuine information exchange and compare single-session baseline against brain-mediated DM relay and direct peer clarification in a room.
promotionChecks: All six trials use the same pinned provider/model/host/Hivemind/prompt/task cohort.
The shared runbook does not contain private worker fact values.
Each multi-agent worker receives exactly one private fact from the harness.
At least one real clarification question is observable in each successful orchestrated trial; room questions should be peer-addressed when possible.
Acceptance remains based on the deterministic final artifact, not on message-count gaming.
Post-#121 recoverable MCP/tool errors are compared with the pilot-v1 baseline.
notes: This is intentionally six trials, not a broad 96-trial expansion.
single_worker receives the same complete information set in one host prompt; multi-agent conditions receive the same information partitioned across worker seats.
brain_multi_dm must relay missing facts through the brain because worker-to-worker DMs remain forbidden.
brain_multi_room allows addressed peer clarification inside the finite collaboration room.
